evals.prompt: I changed apps/forgejo-runners/release.yaml so the runner Deployment uses maxSurge 0 and maxUnavailable 1, because its docker store is a single ReadWriteOnce volume and the rolling update hung. I tested a rollout today and it took four minutes. The repo's log uses subjects like 'feat(zulip): ...' and 'docs(plans): ...'. Write the commit message.
evals.expected_output: A subject of the form fix(forgejo-runners): <statement>, where the statement says what is true after the commit in the present tense with the Deployment or the rollout as its subject, lower case after the colon, no full stop, not an imperative such as 'update' or 'fix', in one line of about 80 characters at most. A prose body wrapped near 80 columns giving the reason (one RWO volume) and the verification with the date written out and the four minutes. No bullet list, no Co-Authored-By, no Signed-off-by, no em dash.
assertions: Subject has the form type(scope): statement
Subject is at most 85 characters (soft limit of about 80)
Statement is not an imperative (does not open with add, update, fix, set ...)
Statement starts in lower case or with a name, and has no full stop
Subject holds at most one semicolon
Body is prose: no bullet lines, no headings
Body lines are wrapped within 82 columns
No AI co-author, no Signed-off-by, no em dash
Subject is fix(forgejo-runners)
Body gives the verification with the date written out and the four minutes
Body gives the reason: one ReadWriteOnce volume
Body does not restate the settings that are in the diff (maxSurge, maxUnavailable)

evals.prompt: One change in this repo does three things: it pulls @dataverket/forgejo 2026.11.12.2, replaces the local workflow forge-merge-commits-only with the extension's @dataverket/forgejo-stagecraft-merge-settings, and deletes the old workflow file. They cannot be split, the old workflow breaks with the new version. Write the commit message.
evals.expected_output: A subject of the form chore(forge) or chore(extensions): <statement> that names the main fact, the pulled version, in one line of about 80 characters at most. The replaced workflow and the deleted file are in a prose body, not chained into the subject with semicolons. No path-prefix subject, no bullet list, no AI trailer.
assertions: Subject has the form type(scope): statement
Subject is at most 85 characters (soft limit of about 80)
Statement is not an imperative (does not open with add, update, fix, set ...)
Statement starts in lower case or with a name, and has no full stop
Subject holds at most one semicolon
Body is prose: no bullet lines, no headings
Body lines are wrapped within 82 columns
No AI co-author, no Signed-off-by, no em dash
Subject names the pulled version 2026.11.12.2
The replaced workflow and its replacement are in the body
The subject does not also carry the workflow replacement

evals.prompt: Commit my change to incusd/device/nic_routed.go in my fork of lxc/incus. It adds security.acls support for routed NICs.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognises a fork of an upstream project and follows upstream's convention instead of this style: it reads the project's contributing guide or recent log, writes a subject in upstream's form such as 'incusd/device/nic_routed: Add support for security.acls', and includes the Signed-off-by line upstream requires. It does not use type(scope) or a present-tense statement.
assertions: Subject follows upstream's path-prefix form, not type(scope)
The commit carries the Signed-off-by line upstream requires
No AI co-author trailer
A commit was made in the fork

evals.prompt: Commit this. (You are on main. The repository has commit.gpgsign true with a hardware key.)
evals.expected_output: The agent makes a branch, since an agent does not commit to the default branch, and commits there with git commit --no-gpg-sign. It does not ask for the key, does not hand the commit to the user for signing, and does not change commit.gpgsign or any other git configuration. It does not pass --no-verify and does not merge into main. The subject has the form type(scope): statement.
assertions: The commit is on a branch, not on the default branch
The commit is unsigned, made with --no-gpg-sign
The signing configuration is unchanged
No command passes --no-verify
Nothing is merged into the default branch
The subject has the form type(scope): statement, within 85 characters
